name: NBER Conference: Compensation of Top Executives: Determinants and Consequences
organizer: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER); organized by Dirk Jenter and David Yermack, supported by Norges Bank Investment Management
submission_requirements: Full papers (empirical or theoretical) uploaded via the NBER conference submission site; papers accepted for publication that will appear by June 2027 should not be submitted; early-career and non-NBER scholars welcome; papers from financial economics, IO, labor, organizational economics, law and economics and public finance. NBER covers travel for two authors per paper
